nt of care. Problems peculiar to top drives, have doubtless been identified by all operations which have used them. PLE OF JAR USAGE Incorrect jar usage has been proved in many cases to have been the primary cause of stuck pipe. Incorrect jar usage often compounds the problems which may eventually lead to the pipe becoming stuck whilst working tight hole. Jarring up into the tight spot defeats the initial objective to free the pipe down. When working into tight spots the jar (if cocked) should be allowed to fire at minimum overpul

. In highly deviated well, drilling torque is greatly increased. A torque sensitive jar which may require surface manipulation with rig tongs before firing is not recommended. Manipulation takes time. Any additional time spent in tight hole situation before taking remedial action is undesirable. If swelling shale is anticipated with corresponding high drag loads it is desirable to have jar with variable downhole firi
